sentences.en: For years, Israel's leaders believed that they could coexist with Hamas.

sentences.en: After this weekend's massacre, that belief is over.
sentences.zh: 但在本周末的大屠杀之后，这种信念破灭了。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Stephen Erlanger, on Israel's plan to destroy Hamas and what it will mean for Palestinians and Israelis.

sentences.en: Wednesday, October 11th.
sentences.zh: 10月11日，星期三。

sentences.en: Steve, we wanted to talk to you because you have been a longtime student of and journalist of the Middle East, Israel, and the Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，我们想和你聊聊，因为你长期以来一直研究中东、以色列和巴勒斯坦人民，也是这方面的记者。

sentences.en: You know this story very well.
sentences.zh: 你对这段历史非常了解。

sentences.en: And we want you to help make sense of Israel's pledge delivered over the past few days to destroy Hamas over the attacks it carried out over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你能帮我们解读一下，以色列在过去几天里承诺要摧毁哈马斯，以回应其周末发动的袭击，这究竟意味着什么。

sentences.en: And I want to start by having you explain what had been Israel's relationship with Hamas before those attacks.
sentences.zh: 我想先请你解释一下，在这些袭击发生之前，以色列与哈马斯的关系是怎样的。

sentences.en: Well, first, let's remember that Hamas is a Palestinian armed group.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先我们要记住，哈马斯是一个巴勒斯坦武装组织。

sentences.en: It was a branch of what Israel originally considered moderate Muslim brotherhood.
sentences.zh: 它最初是以色列所认为的温和派“穆斯林兄弟会”的一个分支。

sentences.en: Hamas began in the 80s as part of a kind of charity group.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯始于80年代，最初是一个慈善团体性质的组织。

sentences.en: They did a lot of social aid.
sentences.zh: 他们做了很多社会援助工作。

sentences.en: They had very well-educated people.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有受过良好教育的人才。

sentences.en: They had doctors.
sentences.zh: 他们有医生。

sentences.en: But as time went on, Hamas, which is dedicated to the destruction of Israel, which on religious basis says Israel has no right to exist,
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，哈马斯——这个致力于摧毁以色列、从宗教角度宣称以色列无权存在的组织，

sentences.en: that all Israeli citizens are soldiers, that they're interlopers into holy Muslim lands, turned more and more toward violence.
sentences.zh: 认为所有以色列公民都是士兵，是神圣穆斯林土地上的入侵者，于是越来越转向暴力。

sentences.en: And Hamas then became more involved with the struggle of the Palestinians against Israeli occupation.
sentences.zh: 随后，哈马斯更多地参与到巴勒斯坦人反抗以色列占领的斗争中。

sentences.en: They buried some of the victims of a suicide bombing that destroyed a crowded bus in Tel Aviv.

sentences.en: And in the 90s became much more of a terrorist group.

sentences.en: 5 bus in downtown Tel Aviv.
sentences.zh: 那次袭击引发了一连串自杀式爆炸，彻底搅乱了以色列。

sentences.en: It set off a set of suicide bombings that really turned Israel upside down.
sentences.zh: 该组织声称对过去两年内的多次自杀式爆炸负责，包括周三在耶路撒冷的公交车爆炸案。

sentences.en: The organization has claimed credit for numerous suicide bombings in the last two years, including Wednesday's bus blast in Jerusalem.

sentences.zh: 这让以色列人意识到，哈马斯是巴勒斯坦武装组织中最危险的，或许也是最鲁莽的。

sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，我清楚地记得那次选举。

sentences.en: It was a stunning development for much of the West, especially for Israel.

sentences.en: It was stunning to Israel and stunning to Washington.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了哈马斯更多的合法性。

sentences.zh: 但在加沙，法塔赫（即巴勒斯坦权力机构目前的核心）控制的约旦河西岸当局试图保持控制权。

sentences.zh: 于是爆发了战争。

sentences.en: And there was a war.
sentences.zh: 加沙内部爆发了内战，哈马斯在2007年以极其残酷的方式赢得了这场战争。

sentences.en: There was a civil war inside Gaza, which Hamas won in a very brutal fashion in 2007.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，它一直控制着加沙。

sentences.en: And it has controlled Gaza ever since.
sentences.zh: 尽管以色列对哈马斯实施了禁运，整个西方也是如此，但以色列意识到它需要与加沙的实际控制者对话。

sentences.en: But Israel, though it had an embargo on Hamas, so did the whole West, Israel realized it needed to talk to someone in control of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯就是那个对话对象。

sentences.en: Hamas was that address.
sentences.zh: 所以无论喜欢与否，无论是否憎恨哈马斯，以色列都有业务需要商谈。

sentences.en: So like it or not, hating Hamas or not, Israel had business to discuss.

sentences.en: So Israel developed a policy in a way of tolerating Hamas, believing that in the long run, the responsibilities of governing Gaza would moderate it.
sentences.zh: 对以色列来说，哈马斯绝非理想的伙伴，但却是一个可以进行业务往来并维持某种现状的对象。

sentences.en: So to Israel, Hamas was not an ideal partner at all, but one that Israel could do business with and maintain a kind of status quo.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这是一个可以被管控的威胁。

sentences.en: In other words, a threat that could be managed.
sentences.zh: 是的，以色列对哈马斯没有任何幻想，暴力也确实存在。

sentences.en: Yes, there were no illusions about Hamas, and there was violence.
sentences.zh: 双方发生了大量的火箭弹交火。

sentences.en: There have been lots of rocket fire back and forth.
sentences.zh: 也发生过恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: There have been terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 有时哈马斯是在回应它认为以色列在约旦河西岸和其他地方的侵略行为。

sentences.en: Sometimes Hamas was responding to what it considered Israeli aggressions in the West Bank and elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯一直有兴趣争取释放被以色列关押的巴勒斯坦囚犯，这就是为什么它过去曾劫持人质试图进行交换。

sentences.en: Hamas has always been interested in trying to get Palestinian prisoners released from Israel, which is why it has taken hostages in the past to try to trade them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在一个著名的案例中，他们扣押了一名以色列士兵五年多，以谈判换取大规模的囚犯释放。

sentences.en: I mean, in a famous case, they kept an Israeli soldier for more than five years while negotiating a massive prisoner release.

sentences.en: And every once in a while, when things get too hot, Israel does a serious bombing campaign.
sentences.zh: 以色列人会派遣军队进入，用他们的话说，进行“割草”。

sentences.en: It's not like he wasn't being pressured sometimes to deal with Hamas, but he understood how hard a war that was going to be,

sentences.en: the number of civilian casualties it would inevitably create inside Gaza, and he always pulled back from it.
sentences.zh: 但现在，由于上周末发生的恐怖事件，这种考量已经改变了。

sentences.en: But now that calculation has changed because of the horrors of what happened last weekend.
sentences.zh: 那种通过容忍哈马斯来管理加沙的想法已经彻底破灭，以色列现在打算做它自2005年撤出加沙以来一直不愿做的事情，

sentences.en: The whole idea of somehow tolerating Hamas to manage Gaza has been exploded, and Israel intends now to do what it was always reluctant to do since it withdrew from Gaza in 2005,

sentences.en: which is to send in ground forces in a serious way to wipe out Hamas.

sentences.en: is a very big and historic pledge to make.
sentences.zh: 我想了解为什么周末发生的事情让以色列走到了它以前从未愿意去的地方。

sentences.en: And I want to understand why what happened over the weekend has brought Israel to that place it never was willing to go before.

sentences.en: And of course, Hamas has planned for this retaliation.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，以色列将不得不面对精心策划的防御，其中包括简易爆炸装置和诱杀装置。

sentences.en: So Israel will have to deal with, I think, well-planned defenses, which will include IEDs, include booby traps.
sentences.zh: 许多哈马斯武装人员穿着平民服装。

sentences.en: Many Hamas fighters wear civilian clothing.
sentences.zh: 他们可以从隧道里钻出来，拿着火箭筒。

sentences.en: They can pop out of tunnels with an RPG.
sentences.zh: 这将使以色列非常非常难以区分普通平民和武装人员。

sentences.en: And this is going to make it very, very difficult for Israel to distinguish between normal civilian and fighter.
sentences.zh: 这正是问题的关键所在。

sentences.en: And that's really the point.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，以色列对哈马斯目标的打击几乎不可避免地会击中或伤害平民。

sentences.en: I mean, it's almost inevitable that Israeli strikes on Hamas targets will hit or wound civilians.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是哈马斯故意生活在他们中间，并将弹药隐藏在他们中间，以及清真寺和医院里。

sentences.en: And it's partly because Hamas deliberately lives among them and hides its munitions among them and in mosques and in hospitals.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼见过这些情况，我不认为这次会有什么不同。

sentences.en: I've seen these things for myself, and I don't expect them to be any different this time.
sentences.zh: 过去，以色列还有一种做法，即在轰炸建筑物前，通过向屋顶投掷铅块来发出警告。

sentences.en: Israel in the past has also had this practice of warning buildings that it's about to bomb by sending a piece of lead down onto the roof.
sentences.zh: 现在以色列说它没有时间那样做了。

sentences.en: Now Israel is saying it no longer has the time to do that.
sentences.zh: 它没有足够的飞机来做这件事。

sentences.en: It doesn't have the aircraft to do that.
sentences.zh: 它正在警告平民，建筑物可能会在没有警告的情况下被轰炸。

sentences.en: It's warning civilians that buildings may be bombed without warning.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于空袭，已经有数百名巴勒斯坦人死亡，数千人流离失所。

sentences.en: And already, from airstrikes, there are hundreds of Palestinians dead and thousands displaced.
sentences.zh: 这些数字只会大幅增加。

sentences.en: Those numbers are only down to go up considerably.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，哈马斯表示，当以色列这样做时，它将公开处决其扣押的约150名人质中的一部分。

sentences.en: Hamas, in contrast, has said when Israel does that, it will publicly execute some of the 150 or so Israeli hostages that it has.
sentences.zh: 以色列面临的另一个困境是，如果他们要大规模进入加沙，在某种程度上意味着他们愿意牺牲这些人质。

sentences.en: The other dilemma for Israel is if they're going to go into Gaza in a big way, in some ways, it means they're willing to sacrifice these hostages.
sentences.zh: 他们会尽力营救他们。

sentences.en: They'll try to save them if they can.
sentences.zh: 他们正在努力寻找他们的下落。

sentences.en: They're trying to find out where they are.
sentences.zh: 但他们已经被分开了。

sentences.en: But they've been split up.
sentences.zh: 他们被转移了位置。

sentences.en: They've been moved around.
sentences.zh: 他们被关进了地下室。

sentences.en: They've been put into basements.
sentences.zh: 同时打击哈马斯并担心人质的安全将是非常困难的。

sentences.en: It's going to be very hard to fight Hamas and worry about the hostages all at the same time.
sentences.zh: 同时打击哈马斯并担心人质的安全将是非常困难的。

sentences.en: Does that lead you to believe that Israel will or will not show some level of restraint,
sentences.zh: 这是否让你认为以色列会或不会表现出某种程度的克制，

sentences.en: given that Israeli hostages will be in this theoretical war zone?
sentences.zh: 考虑到以色列人质将身处这个理论上的战区？

sentences.en: It's a very good question, and I'm not sure the answer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题，我不确定答案。

sentences.en: Israel has always taken Israeli lives incredibly seriously.
sentences.zh: 以色列一直非常认真地对待以色列人的生命。

sentences.en: I mean, it was willing to trade thousands of prisoners for one Israeli soldier.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它曾愿意用数千名囚犯换取一名以色列士兵。

sentences.en: And to have 150 civilians inside Gaza creates an enormous moral dilemma, an enormous strategic dilemma.
sentences.zh: 而在加沙境内有150名平民，这造成了巨大的道德困境，巨大的战略困境。

sentences.en: But I think force protection has to be the main and crucial thing.
sentences.zh: 但我认为部队保护必须是主要且关键的事情。

sentences.en: And they're going to save the people they can save.
sentences.zh: 他们会去拯救他们能拯救的人。

sentences.en: But I don't think, given this war, they can worry overly much about any individual hostage.
sentences.zh: 但考虑到这场战争，我不认为他们能过多地担心任何个人质。

sentences.en: I want to understand, back to the goal of this offensive, destroying Hamas, what the chances are that Israel really can actually wipe out Hamas.
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下，回到这次进攻的目标——摧毁哈马斯，以色列真正能够彻底消灭哈马斯的几率有多大。

sentences.en: That's its stated goal.
sentences.zh: 这是它宣称的目标。

sentences.en: What does that really even look like?
sentences.zh: 那到底是什么样子呢？

sentences.en: Does that mean capturing or killing the most senior leaders of the organization?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着抓捕或击毙该组织最高级别的领导人？

sentences.en: It has been the elected government.
sentences.zh: 它一直是民选政府。

sentences.en: So does it mean removing all of Hamas's officials from every level of government?
sentences.zh: 那么这是否意味着要从各级政府中清除所有哈马斯官员？

sentences.en: How should we understand that?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何理解这一点？

sentences.en: Well, they took power over Gaza.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们夺取了加沙的权力。

sentences.en: They installed themselves, right?
sentences.zh: 他们是自立为王的，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it's not like this is some wonderfully democratically elected government that is suddenly about to fall.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这并不是说这是一个多么美妙的民选政府，突然就要倒台了。

sentences.en: Once they took over, they ran a pretty tough government.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们接管，他们就实行了相当强硬的统治。

sentences.en: They set out after their enemies.
sentences.zh: 他们对敌人穷追猛打。

sentences.en: They mistreated them.
sentences.zh: 他们虐待他们。

sentences.en: They run the place pretty strongly.
sentences.zh: 他们非常强硬地管理着这个地方。

sentences.en: So it's very hard to get a really good sense of public opinion.
sentences.zh: 所以很难真正了解公众舆论。

sentences.en: The last major Palestinian poll there was in 2021.
sentences.zh: 上一次主要的巴勒斯坦民调是在2021年。

sentences.en: And 20, 30 percent of people favored Hamas then.
sentences.zh: 当时有20%到30%的人支持哈马斯。

sentences.en: I'm sure now it's much less.
sentences.zh: 我相信现在肯定少多了。

sentences.en: And also Gazans now are really terrified of what's going to happen after this great Hamas victory, so-called.
sentences.zh: 而且加沙人现在也非常害怕在这场所谓的哈马斯大胜之后会发生什么。

sentences.en: They're waiting for Israel's retaliation, and they are terrified.
sentences.zh: 他们正在等待以色列的报复，他们感到恐惧。

sentences.en: But Israel, I don't think, can destroy Hamas, in my own personal opinion.
sentences.zh: 但我个人认为，以色列无法摧毁哈马斯。

sentences.en: I believe Hamas's leaders, and particularly its military leaders, are probably no longer in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我相信哈马斯的领导人，尤其是其军事领导人，可能已经不在加沙了。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, because they can control the battle from outside.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为他们可以在外面指挥战斗。

sentences.en: Their lives are obviously very valuable.
sentences.zh: 他们的生命显然非常有价值。

sentences.en: And Israel has tried to kill them in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 而且以色列过去曾试图杀死他们。

sentences.en: So they may be in very sophisticated bunkers way underground.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能在地下深处非常复杂的掩体中。

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: They may be in tunnels way underground.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在地下深处的隧道里。

sentences.en: That's quite possible.
sentences.zh: 这很有可能。

sentences.en: They may have slipped into Egypt.
sentences.zh: 他们可能已经溜进了埃及。

sentences.en: That's possible, too.
sentences.zh: 那也有可能。

sentences.en: So it's going to be very hard to destroy the Hamas leadership.
sentences.zh: 所以要摧毁哈马斯领导层将非常困难。

sentences.en: But Israel will try to dismantle the power structure, the military structure of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 但以色列会试图拆除哈马斯的权力结构和军事结构。

sentences.en: But the big question everyone has is, well, what happens the next day?
sentences.zh: 但每个人心中的大问题是，好吧，第二天会发生什么？

sentences.en: Do the Israelis stay?
sentences.zh: 以色列人会留下来吗？

sentences.en: How long do they stay?
sentences.zh: 他们会待多久？

sentences.en: And also, one shouldn't rule out that there will be uprisings among other Palestinians, both inside Israel, inside the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 此外，也不应排除在以色列境内和西岸境内，其他巴勒斯坦人会发生起义的可能性。

sentences.en: Israel could find that its efforts in Gaza produce much more anger and resistance than it necessarily expects.
sentences.zh: 以色列可能会发现，它在加沙的努力产生的愤怒和抵抗比它预期的要多得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That is a question I think has to be on everyone's mind.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个问题一定在每个人的脑海中。

sentences.en: If Israel succeeds in any way in dismantling Hamas, what will replace it?
sentences.zh: 如果以色列在某种程度上成功拆除了哈马斯，什么会取代它？

sentences.en: And will Israel attempt to influence what replaces it and thus won't, whatever government that becomes, be very suspicious to Palestinians living in Gaza?
sentences.zh: 以色列会试图影响取代它的东西吗？如果是这样，无论那个政府变成什么样，住在加沙的巴勒斯坦人难道不会非常怀疑吗？

sentences.en: Won't it be seen as a puppet government of Israel and not legitimate?
sentences.zh: 它难道不会被视为以色列的傀儡政府，而不具合法性吗？

sentences.en: And doesn't that therefore make this entire mission potentially a slow motion backfiring on Israel?
sentences.zh: 因此，这难道不会使整个任务对以色列来说可能变成一场缓慢的反噬吗？

sentences.en: If, in fact, the Israelis get that far, right?
sentences.zh: 如果以色列真的能走那么远的话，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, part of their problem is they can kill a lot of Hamas soldiers.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们的问题之一是他们可以杀死很多哈马斯士兵。

sentences.en: They can destroy a lot of equipment and arMs.
sentences.zh: 他们可以摧毁大量的装备和武器。

sentences.en: They can go house to house.
sentences.zh: 他们可以挨家挨户地搜查。

sentences.en: But they can't prevent the idea of Palestinian resistance.
sentences.zh: 但他们无法阻止巴勒斯坦抵抗运动的思想。

sentences.en: They can't extinguish that.
sentences.zh: 他们无法熄灭那种思想。

sentences.en: And I'm sure some group will come to replace Hamas.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信会有某个组织来取代哈马斯。

sentences.en: So, no, I don't think you can kill the Palestinian idea.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，我不认为你能扼杀巴勒斯坦人的思想。

sentences.en: The problem is Gaza, as someone said to me, for Israel, it's like a one-word argument for the dangers of giving up control and trusting Palestinians to run their own affairs.
sentences.zh: 问题在于加沙，正如有人对我说的，对于以色列来说，这是一个关于放弃控制权并信任巴勒斯坦人管理自己事务的危险性的单字论点。

sentences.en: And Gaza, for Palestinians and Palestinian supporters, is a one-word argument for Israeli brutality and patronization and colonization of another people.
sentences.zh: 而对于巴勒斯坦人和巴勒斯坦支持者来说，加沙是一个关于以色列残暴、恩赐和殖民他人的单字论点。

sentences.en: And that's a bridge that's very hard to get over.
sentences.zh: 那是一道很难跨越的鸿沟。

sentences.en: Steve, what you're getting at is what many see as the utter intractability of this situation long-term.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，你所说的是许多人认为的这种局势长期以来的彻底棘手性。

sentences.en: And that makes me want to understand, based on your reporting, what this moment is supposed to solve for either side.
sentences.zh: 这让我想要了解，根据你的报道，这一刻对于任何一方来说应该解决什么问题。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say that Hamas knew its attack inside Israel would elicit a very strong response.
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，哈马斯知道它在以色列境内的袭击会引发非常强烈的反应。

sentences.en: And it's now facing what could be its own demise.
sentences.zh: 而它现在正面临可能导致自身灭亡的局面。

sentences.en: And Israel may end up with an even more aggressive group governing Gaza once Hamas is out of power, if that happens.
sentences.zh: 如果哈马斯下台，以色列最终可能会面对一个更激进的组织来统治加沙，如果这种情况发生的话。

sentences.en: So, what's really going to have been accomplished here?
sentences.zh: 那么，这里到底完成了什么？

sentences.en: Well, for Hamas, in a way, it was a way to remind the world the Palestinian problem still exists.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于哈马斯来说，在某种程度上，这是一种提醒世界巴勒斯坦问题依然存在的方式。

sentences.en: Israel, as you know, has been negotiating with American help to have normalization with Saudi Arabia, to have a defense treaty between Saudi Arabia and the United States.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，以色列一直在美国帮助下进行谈判，以实现与沙特阿拉伯的正常化，并达成沙特阿拉伯与美国之间的防务条约。

sentences.en: And the Palestinians were always kind of considered in the way of this.
sentences.zh: 而巴勒斯坦人总是被认为挡了路。

sentences.en: I mean, everyone made kind of lip service to, oh, we have to do something for the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每个人都只是口头上说，哦，我们必须为巴勒斯坦人做点什么。

sentences.en: But they were very much put on the side.
sentences.zh: 但他们很大程度上被放在了一边。

sentences.en: And I think part of what Hamas was doing was reminding the world that the idea of this kind of peace, the Middle East, is a bloody mirage.
sentences.zh: 我认为哈马斯所做的一部分是在提醒世界，这种中东和平的想法是一个血腥的海市蜃楼。

sentences.en: And the Palestinian question cannot be ignored.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦问题是不容忽视的。

sentences.en: For Israel, what matters now is to show the Middle East that it is a ruthless, powerful military force that will never be attacked this way again.
sentences.zh: 对于以色列来说，现在重要的是向中东展示它是一支冷酷、强大的军事力量，永远不会再受到这样的攻击。

sentences.en: The whole point of these regional deals that Israel has been making with the Gulf, with the Saudis,
sentences.zh: 以色列一直在与海湾国家、沙特人进行的这些区域协议的全部意义，

sentences.en: comes from the Arab world's understanding that Israel is a fact of life in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 源于阿拉伯世界对以色列是中东既定事实的理解。

sentences.en: It's ineradicable, which was never really the judgment from 67 or 73.
sentences.zh: 它是不可根除的，这在67年或73年时从未真正成为共识。

sentences.en: And now the weakness Israel's displayed in its loss to Hamas undercuts that fact of ineradic ability.
sentences.zh: 而现在以色列在输给哈马斯中所表现出的软弱，削弱了这种不可根除的事实。

sentences.en: And Israelis feel they have to restore it, despite the cost to their own citizens.
sentences.zh: 以色列人觉得他们必须恢复它，尽管这要付出他们自己公民的代价。

sentences.en: Each side is trying to show the world that the facts it represents will not go away.
sentences.zh: 每一方都在试图向世界展示它所代表的事实不会消失。

sentences.en: Hamas is proving to the world that Palestine in question exists.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯正在向世界证明巴勒斯坦问题是存在的。

sentences.en: It cannot be shoved under the carpet or ignored forever.
sentences.zh: 它不能被扫地出门或永远被忽视。

sentences.en: And Israel needs to show that it will stay a powerful state in the Middle East, that it is a fact of life, and that it will never be eliminated.
sentences.zh: 而以色列需要展示它将保持中东强国的地位，它是既定事实，且永远不会被消灭。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And of course, in the middle of those two very powerful statements that both sides are making, have been, and I presume will be, many dead civilians.
sentences.zh: 当然，在双方都在发表的这两个非常强有力的声明中间，已经并将继续会有许多平民死亡。

sentences.en: There will be many dead civilians.
sentences.zh: 会有许多平民死亡。

sentences.en: Well, Steve, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，史蒂夫，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, Israel said it had re-established control of the towns attacked by Hamas, as the full scope of the assault came into greater relief.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，以色列表示已重新控制了被哈马斯袭击的城镇，随着袭击的全面范围变得更加清晰。

sentences.en: The death toll within Israel surpassed 1,000 people, and Israeli officials said they had recovered the bodies of 1,500 Palestinian assailants,
sentences.zh: 以色列境内的死亡人数超过了1000人，以色列官员表示他们已经找回了1500名巴勒斯坦袭击者的尸体，

sentences.en: highlighting just how many fighters were involved in the attack.
sentences.zh: 凸显了有多少武装人员参与了这次袭击。

sentences.en: As Israel's counteroffensive intensified, the number of dead in Gaza reached at least 900 people.
sentences.zh: 随着以色列反攻的加剧，加沙的死亡人数至少达到了900人。

sentences.en: Finally, in Washington.
sentences.zh: 最后，在华盛顿。

sentences.en: You know, there are moments in this life,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这个生命中有一些时刻，

sentences.en: and I mean this literally, when the pure, unadulterated evil is unleashed on this world.
sentences.zh: 我是说真的，当纯粹的、不加掩饰的邪恶在这个世界上释放时。

sentences.en: The people of Israel lived through one such moment this weekend.
sentences.zh: 以色列人民在这个周末经历了一个这样的时刻。

sentences.en: President Biden denounced Hamas as bloodthirsty terrorist, and called the group's attack, quote, an act of sheer evil.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统谴责哈马斯是嗜血的恐怖分子，并称该组织的袭击是“纯粹的邪恶行为”。

sentences.en: So in this moment, we must be crystal clear.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个时刻，我们必须非常清楚。

sentences.en: We stand with Israel.
sentences.zh: 我们与以色列站在一起。

sentences.en: We stand with Israel.
sentences.zh: 我们与以色列站在一起。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnaloo.
sentences.zh: 我是Winnaloo。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Mazursky，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com/games立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的事情。

sentences.en: The Times reports that allies of former Republican House Speaker Kevin McCarthy, who was ousted last week, are trying to engineer a potential vote to reinstate him.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，上周被罢免的前共和党众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡的盟友们正试图策划一次潜在的投票来恢复他的职位。

sentences.en: An idea that McCarthy is open to.
sentences.zh: 这是一个麦卡锡持开放态度的想法。

sentences.en: House Republicans are expected to select their next speaker as early as today.
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人预计最早将于今天选出他们的下一任议长。

sentences.en: The two leading candidates are Representative Steve Scalise of Louisiana and Representative Jim Jordan of Ohio, but it's unclear whether either of them has enough support.
sentences.zh: 两位主要候选人是路易斯安那州的史蒂夫·斯卡利斯众议员和俄亥俄州的吉姆·乔丹众议员，但目前尚不清楚他们中是否有足够的支持。

sentences.en: And, on Tuesday, Representative George Santos, the embattled New York Republican, was charged with 10 more crimes,
sentences.zh: 而且，周二，陷入困境的纽约州共和党众议员乔治·桑托斯被控另外10项罪名，

sentences.en: including stealing the identities and credit cards of donors to his campaign.
sentences.zh: 包括窃取其竞选捐款人的身份和信用卡。

sentences.en: In one case, Santos allegedly stole a donor's credit card number to transfer more than $11,000 to his own bank account.
sentences.zh: 在其中一起案件中，桑托斯涉嫌窃取了一名捐款人的信用卡号码，将超过11000美元转入他自己的银行账户。

sentences.en: Santos now faces a total of 23 federal charges.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯现在总共面临23项联邦指控。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Carlos Prieto,
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Carlos Prieto制作，

sentences.en: Astha Chaturvedi, and Will Reed.
sentences.zh: Astha Chaturvedi和Will Reed。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willens and Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由Patricia Willens和Lisa Chow编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Dan Powell,
sentences.zh: 包含Dan Powell的原创音乐，

sentences.en: Mary Lozano, Diane Wong, and Pat McCusker, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: Mary Lozano、Diane Wong和Pat McCusker，并由Alyssa Moxley进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的Jim Brunberg和Ben Lansford创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是Michael Bavaro。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱，有时甚至是惊心动魄的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一集中，我和Sarah Koenig一起，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在此过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
